title: Archive through September 28, 2003 - Anonymous (Tuesday, September 16, 2003 - 09:09 pm)
content: I was taken to a dark room and placed on a slab. Then, a man came in and spoke to me about my condition. He was dressed in a black hooded shroud very satanic. He said he could help me...help me with what? I don’t know to this day what I needed his help with. He left my sight & I started to look around the area I was in. It was what looked like a mid-evil dungeon. The next thing I know the man returns with a woman and tells me that they can help. And then cuts off both my legs. Puts my body and legs in a box and seals the box. I then watch the box with me in side of it put in the back of a wagon and taken to a furnace and put into it. Once the box is put in I found my-self in the box with flames licking at me. I then awoke in a hospital bed. 2 weeks had passed. My last memories were of riding my motorcycle on the evening of May 11, 1997 and then it was the afternoon of May 27. I was in the hospital bed with a broken foot, both legs, back, hand and skull.

arrival.other_being_detail: A man in a black hooded shroud described as "very satanic," later returning with a woman; they claim they can help and then cut off both legs and place body/legs in a box that is taken to a furnace.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Motorcycle accident implied: "My last memories were of riding my motorcycle on the evening of May 11, 1997."

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Experience centers on being in a dungeon-like room, interaction with a satanic-looking hooded man and a woman, mutilation (legs cut off), being boxed and taken to a furnace with flames; then awakening in hospital after 2 weeks.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE/tunnel/light/life review described; instead an immediate dark dungeon scenario with hostile beings and furnace imagery, followed by awakening in hospital.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Hostile, dungeon-like scenario involving a "very satanic" hooded man and a woman who cut off both legs, place body and legs in a sealed box, transport it by wagon to a furnace, and flames are experienced inside the box before awakening.

Puts my body and legs in a box and seals the box."; "Once the box is put in I found my-self in the box with flames licking at me."
